entities.name: Daeng Soetigna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daeng Soetigna was a famous music teacher who is considered the father of modern angklung music. He redesigned the ancient Indonesian instrument, enabling it to play international music. He was also active in staging angklung orchestras in various regions in Indonesia.
